cd /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip && git add packages/adapters/claude-local/src/server/parse.ts packages/adapters/claude-local/src/server/execute.ts packages/adapters/claude-local/src/server/index.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(claude-local): retry with fresh session when claude exits non-zero

Claude reports the unknown-session error in two ways:
  1. Exits 0 with parsed.result text \"No conversation found...\" — the
     existing isClaudeUnknownSessionError(parsed) catches this.
  2. Exits 1 and writes the error to stderr without producing JSON
     stream output — parsed is null, so the existing check returns
     false and the retry-with-fresh-session fallback never fires.
     The agent run surfaces a hard \"adapter_failed\" to the user.

Add detectClaudeUnknownSession({ parsed, stdout, stderr }) which checks
all three signals against the same regex. execute.ts uses the new
detector for the retry decision so case 2 also triggers the fresh
session retry.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
